title: The Echo of New Lagos Again
author: Juniper Coldharbour
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
